High-resolution (600 dpi) image of strangewayes' print-ready errata card for [[Captain Piett (Decipher Errata 1998)]] (the card with its Decipher errata text and the errata mark) (Hoth, Dark Side), from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]].

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Errata/Dark_E/Captain Piett _ E.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/1gFTwnhWtFbe5TrnU2HEXmJJE8KEO4Cn_/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>Captain Piett _ E.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,339,168 bytes, SHA-256 <code>35f0f6ac889e4346634f56717a990e4e61d8ed60f1a89a7c7f7ce656b907b707</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the image, 44.5, 47.5, 72.5, 57.0 px); resized: no; no other change.

This is a fan print, not a Decipher or Players Committee card. It is listed in the card's versions list as “strangewayes print (fan re-set)” and is not shown on [[Captain Piett (Decipher Errata 1998)]] (Bill, 22 November 2026).

Credit: image by strangewayes for the HiRez scanning project; used here with credit to that project.
